$comment: D-CSUBSET-COUNTER-MACRO-NOT-EXPANDED: `__COUNTER__` is a predefined macro whose value is a per-TRANSLATION-UNIT counter advancing ONCE PER EXPANSION. ★★ WHY TWO USES AND NOT ONE: at the pre-change HEAD `DSS_CAT(v_, __COUNTER__)` pasted the LITERAL TEXT and minted a symbol named `v___COUNTER__`; a SINGLE use compiled CLEAN, linked and ran, so a one-use example would have passed against the broken behaviour, while TWO uses at file scope collided into S0002 + S0001. That this TU compiles AT ALL is therefore the distinctness assertion, and it is a COMPILE-time one no runtime arm could weaken. FOUR arms: (1+2) `v_0` and `v_1` are named directly, pinning the numbering DECISION — start at 0, step by 1, which is what gcc 13.3.0, clang 18.1.3 and clang 19.1.1 all do (MEASURED); nothing observable should depend on the integer, but the decision to agree was deliberate and is pinned so it cannot drift silently; (3) three reads inside ONE declaration must yield 2, 3, 4, so an implementation advancing per SOURCE LINE — or caching per position — scores 0 while passing 1 and 2; (4) the two minted objects are distinct STORAGE, not merely distinct names. ANTI-FOLD: the score is multiplied by a runtime `argc` predicate so the release pipeline cannot reduce main to a constant return. Data-model-independent (int arithmetic only), so the one exit code holds on all four targets and on the shipped release pipeline. exit = 42 * 1 * 1 * 1 = 42.
